answer: A new key begins as a hollow shell allowed only tiny unpaid practice jobs. To earn real pay it must finish a voyage of twelve rungs, each a harder task scored by a different stranger drawn at random, and it can climb at most one rung per epoch. Every fake key therefore costs months of genuine skilled work before it can vote or earn, and one failed rung sends a ripple back to the start, so cheap clones rarely reach the pay tier.
